notes.title: Version 1.2 - Hardcore mode, Steam achievements, Autofire and Speedrun Timer
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43222697/2704539a82a8c058b85ad8a23c7f390ae825bd25.png
Hi!
We are very happy to release the newest update for Space Yugoslav 2D so far, that now includes:

- new HARDCORE MODE that unlocks after normal finish of the game, that doubles the numbers of the enemies on the screen for more intense action, than it is already in regular mode
- added 10 STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS that you can earn through game progress
- AUTOFIRE TOGGLE enables you to shoot without pressing the fire button
- SPEEDRUN TIMER, that doesn't stop on pausing the game and that helps you measure how long it takes for you to beat the game on any try and mode

All your feedback is very appreciated and we wish you happy and exciting gaming!
